data.narrative:
Echodyne is a Series C-stage defense and security frontier-tech company that has raised $224M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 13 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Quantum-Systems, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $224M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implying a valuation of $381M. The peer-median method triangulates across the 13-company comp set, which exhibits a median valuation of $2.1B and a wide range from $300M to $18.0B. The peer set includes Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), Helsing at $18.0B (Series D), and Saronic at $9.2B (Series D).

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $324M (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty around which peer comparables are most representative of Echodyne's risk-return profile and revenue-stage maturity. The peer set's wide dispersion—driven by large late-stage rounds in adjacent defense subsectors—suggests that stage-specific positioning and product differentiation meaningfully influence defensibility within this sector.
